Table of Contents Shrutika Patil September 21, 2026 6:00 pm Mohini Gajare’s journey can help you understand how learning Software Testing step by step can help you move towards a career in IT . She started by learning the basics, practicing what she learned, and slowly building confidence in her skills. Mohini joined the STEP in Software Testing – Python program at 3RI Technologies to learn Software Testing in a structured way. During the training, she worked on testing concepts, practical tasks, and Python-related skills. The guidance from the trainers helped her understand the topics better and become more confident with her learning. After completing her training, Mohini moved ahead in her career and started working in Software Testing at XtrazCon . Her experience shows that with regular practice and proper training, students can build the skills they need to take their first step into the IT industry. The Challenge For Mohini, the important question was not only what to learn but also how to use that knowledge in actual testing work . She wanted to understand the testing process in a practical way and get familiar with the tools used by testers. Finding the right Software Testing classes in Pune helped her learn through proper training, practice what she learned, and clear her doubts. Email Phone Send The Learning Approach at 3RI Technologies To learn Software Testing in a proper way, Mohini chose the 5-month STEP in Software Testing – Python program at 3RI Technologies . The training covers important areas such as Manual Testing, Automation Testing, Python, Selenium, and other testing concepts. The program also focuses on practical learning through assignments and projects , helping you understand how testing is done in real work situations. Along with technical training, learners get trainer guidance, interview preparation, and placement assistance to support their career journey. For Mohini, having a place to learn, practice, ask questions, and improve her skills step by step made the learning experience more useful and comfortable. The Software Testing Training Path Mohini spent 5 months learning Software Testing through the STEP in Software Testing – Python program at 3RI Technologies . The training started with the basics and slowly moved to testing tools, practical tasks, projects, and interview preparation. Learning everything step by step helped her understand the topics clearly and get ready to start working in Software Testing. Month 1 – Getting Started: The first stage focused on the basics of software and testing. This helped her understand what testing is and why it is needed. Month 2 – Manual Testing: She moved into important testing concepts such as test cases, different types of testing, defect tracking, and the overall testing process. Month 3 – Automation & Selenium: The next stage introduced automation testing and Selenium, giving her an idea of how testing can be done with tools instead of only manual methods. Month 4 – Tools & Practical Work: She worked with testing tools and practiced through assignments and project-based activities. This gave her a better idea of how testing knowledge is used in real work. Month 5 – Projects & Career Preparation: The final stage focused more on practical projects, interview preparation, and getting ready for the job search. The program also includes placement assistance to support learners during their career journey. By following the training step by step, practicing the skills, and gaining hands-on experience through projects, Mohini became better prepared to enter the professional world. Her consistent efforts and learning journey eventually helped her secure an opportunity with XtrazCon as a Software Tester , marking an important step forward in her career. The Outcome of Software Testing Training The Software Testing training at 3RI Technologies helped Mohini move from learning basic concepts to getting a better idea of how testing is done in real projects. She had the chance to practice different testing tasks, explore useful tools, and work on practical assignments during her training. With regular practice and career guidance, she gradually became more comfortable with the skills needed for a software testing role. The training gave Mohini more than just technical knowledge. It gave her a chance to practice, understand her strengths, and become familiar with the kind of work involved in software testing. The practical exposure also helped her speak about her skills with more confidence during the job search. Her experience shows how consistent learning and hands-on practice can help turn training into a real career opportunity. After completing her learning journey at 3RI Technologies, Mohini was able to take her first professional step as a Software Tester at XtrazCon .
